regions.cleaned_text: Ralph Cotter - 24 - spinal maningitis - hopeless enrolled yesterday, now reported without headache - Father had been away from Confession for five years - went to Communion this a.m ... Aug. 30 Said R. Cotter returned Home May 6th ( 12th) day). Drs. had given him 48 hours to live (Apr. 24) He comes To-night in perfect health - 20 1bs. heavier than before he was sick .... Thank be to God. March 13, 1947 Same R.C. Married about 5 yrs. later. Still on the job. Fr. S.
